Cognition, Cost & Cosmic Puzzles
July 4, 2026
SCIENCE
CO2 in Meeting Rooms Kills Decision Quality
Research shows CO2 in closed rooms reaches 2,000+ ppm, causing measurable
cognitive impairment. At 2,500 ppm, 7 of 9 decision metrics become "dysfunctional."
▸ At 1,000 ppm: performance drops on 6 of 9 decision metrics vs 600 ppm baseline
▸ Closed rooms reach 1,000 ppm within the first hour of occupancy
▸ Real-world reading: 2,143 ppm — nearly 5× outdoor CO2 (~400 ppm)
BUSINESS
Costco Thrives as Deliberate Amazon Opposite
Costco's ~4,000 SKU model, membership fees, and no third-party sellers make it a
structural counter to Amazon. Intentional scarcity builds trust that scale cannot replicate.
▸ Costco stocks ~4,000 SKUs; Amazon hosts hundreds of millions of product listings
▸ US/Canada annual membership renewal rate exceeds 90%
▸ No third-party sellers — Costco takes full responsibility for every product
AI
AI Inference Cost Falls: New GLM-5.2 Benchmarks
Wafer.ai's GLM-5.2 on AMD GPUs delivers frontier-competitive results at dramatically
lower cost, via Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter. Performance-per-dollar accelerating.
▸ GLM-5.2 runs on AMD GPUs, diversifying inference beyond NVIDIA dominance
▸ Available via Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter for broad API access
▸ AI perf-per-dollar improving faster than traditional Moore's Law compute gains

Mistral Leanstral 1.5 Automates Math Proof Generation
Mistral AI released Leanstral 1.5, specializing in formal mathematical proof generation
using the Lean theorem prover, aiming for "proof abundance" beyond specialist labs.
▸ Uses Lean formal proof language — enables machine-checkable mathematical verification
▸ Targets theorem proving tasks previously requiring weeks of expert mathematician time
▸ Part of Mistral's expanding portfolio: OCR 4, Medium 3.5, Small 4, Voxtral TTS
SCIENCE
Webb Telescope Reveals Galaxies That Shouldn't Exist
JWST surfaces early-universe galaxies 10–100× more massive than Lambda-CDM
models predict. Astrophysicists openly call for revisions to fundamental cosmology.
▸ JWST galaxies at redshift z>10 are 10–100× more massive than model predictions
▸ Hubble Tension — expansion rate discrepancy — remains unresolved alongside findings
▸ Some researchers propose revising dark matter models or early star formation rates
SCIENCE
Giant Trees Defy Physics to Reach 57 Meters
Exeter research on Borneo's Dipterocarp trees overturns the assumption that hydraulic
resistance limits tree height — vascular architecture precisely compensates throughout.
▸ Dipterocarp trees reach 57 meters (≈19 stories) in Borneo and Southeast Asia
▸ Researchers accessed canopy via double rope technique (DRT), pub. July 2, 2026
▸ Xylem vessels taper at branch junctions — minimizing hydraulic resistance at height
